faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes ML63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The ML63 AMG uses the M156 - a 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8. It was fitted to the W164 generation from 2005 to 2011.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes ML63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my ML63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact M156 spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M156 ML63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the camshaft adjuster, timing chain and bearings as standard on every M156 rebuild - addressing the known pre-2012 wear patterns.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used ML63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my ML63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an ML63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most ML63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
